title: dryopteris affinis var. splendens
intro: Dryopteris affinis var. splendens, commonly known as the golden back spleenwort, is a fern species belonging to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of golden back spleenwort include its ability to reduce inflammation, calm the nervous system, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential natural remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
